messages.content: Help me generate the XContent with xContentBuilderInstance for a RootObjectMapper that includes default settings for dynamic date formats, dynamic templates, date detection, and numeric detection, while skipping runtime fields?

function.name: RootObjectMapper_doXContent
function.description: Serializes the RootObjectMapper settings to XContent, with options to include default values and to skip runtime fields. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

builder.description: The XContentBuilder to which the content should be written. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

params.description: Parameters controlling the serialization, including whether to include defaults and whether to skip runtime fields. This is Java ArrayList type parameter in string representation. The list elements are of type any; they are not in string representation.

message.content:
Sure! To serialize a `RootObjectMapper` to XContent while ensuring that all default settings (dynamic date formats, dynamic templates, date detection, numeric detection) are included **and** runtime fields are omitted, you’ll want to invoke the helper with the following arguments:

```json
{
  "builder": "xContentBuilderInstance",
  "params": "[true, true]"
}
```

### What this does

| Parameter | Value | Effect |
|-----------|-------|--------|
| `builder` | `"xContentBuilderInstance"` | A reference to your existing `XContentBuilder` instance where the mapper’s JSON will be written. |
| `params` | `"[true, true]"` | An `ArrayList` represented as a string. The first element (`true`) tells the serializer to **include default values** (so dynamic date formats, dynamic templates, date detection, numeric detection, etc., are all written out). The second element (`true`) tells it to **skip runtime fields**, preventing any runtime‑only properties from being emitted. |

### How to call it

```javascript
functions.RootObjectMapper_doXContent({
  builder: "xContentBuilderInstance",
  params: "[true, true]"
});
```

When executed, this will write the full mapping definition—including all default configurations—to the supplied `XContentBuilder`, but it will omit any runtime‑only fields.
